name: @tetherto/mdk-plugin-mvp-site
description: MVP-site example plugin: aggregates the site (miners, a powermeter, a mining pool) via the MDK protocol client over the RPC listener.

200.description: Live site snapshot: miners, site power, and pools.

routes.description: Live site snapshot assembled from telemetry.pull across all workers: all miners, site power consumption from powermeters, and pool data from all minerpool workers.

200.description: Historical time-series read from a worker tail-log.

routes.description: Historical telemetry from the workers' persisted tail-logs (telemetry.pull type 'logs'). metric=hashrate reads pool stats-history (all pools summed by default; pass deviceId for one pool). metric=site-hashrate reads the miners' own snap tail-logs summed across all miners (MH/s; pass deviceId for one miner). metric=power reads site powermeter series (all meters summed by default; pass deviceId for one meter). metric=temperature reads sensor tail-logs, averaged by default; this example ships no sensor Worker, so it returns empty unless one is added. Defaults to the last hour.

200.description: What the signed-in user may do on this site.

routes.description: The signed-in user's identity, the roles spec.rbac binds to them, which site routes they may call, and which miners they may send each command to. Advisory, for the UI: the Gateway and the Kernel enforce the same policy on every call.

200.description: The Kernel's write-command log, newest first.

routes.description: Every miner command attempted on this site, newest first, refused ones included: who sent it (the operator, via the site app), the roles they held, the command, the target device, and the outcome. Reads the Kernel's write-command log (command.log), so the caller needs commands: read.

200.description: Command dispatched to the miner via Kernel.

routes.description: Dispatches the setPowerMode capability command to a single miner through Kernel. The new mode appears on the next telemetry poll.
constraints: mode must be one of low | normal | high.

200.description: setupPools command dispatched to the miner via Kernel.

routes.description: Dispatches the setupPools capability command to a single miner through Kernel. Pools from the request body take precedence; with no body the site-wide default from config/site.deploy.json (worker.pools) is applied. The miner reboots to pick up the new pools, so expect it to drop offline briefly.
constraints: At most 3 pools per miner (whatsminer API limit).
Each pool needs url and worker_name; appendId=false disables the per-device worker-name suffix.
